mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 8.0% indicates a weak labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain low interest rates, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime (defined by UNRATE > 8.0% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative monetary policy supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls exceeding 100,000 (100 in thousands) indicates a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS monthly change > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above its 12-month moving average signals expanding manufacturing activity, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 12mo_avg.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year change in CPI below 2.0% signals low inflation, allowing the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative monetary policy, which supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy_change < 2.0%.
